author: Codex /root/runtime_gaps
arguments_contract: -e <setup> <selected script.lua> a b c, always explicit argv with no shell; no original main.lua/source equivalent is emitted

cases.setup: case_name="unchanged-strings";;check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==3 and v[1]=='a' and v[2]=='b' and v[3]=='c') end
cases.purpose: Baseline actual selected-script host argv.

cases.setup: case_name="numeric-slot";arg[1]=100;check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==3 and type(v[1])=='number' and math.type(v[1])=='integer' and v[1]==100 and v[2]=='b' and v[3]=='c') end
cases.purpose: Original main274-276 plus actual numeric type, not printed-string equality.

cases.setup: case_name="boolean-slot";arg[2]=false;check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==3 and v[1]=='a' and v[2]==false and v[3]=='c') end
cases.purpose: Actual boolean value survives host-to-script publication.

cases.setup: case_name="replace-table";arg={11,true,"text"};check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==3 and v[1]==11 and v[2]==true and v[3]=='text') end
cases.purpose: Current global table is read after -e rather than host argv reused.

cases.setup: case_name="replace-empty";arg={};check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==0) end
cases.purpose: Actual replacement table length determines zero argument count.

cases.setup: case_name="mixed-object-identity";want={};fn=function()end;co=coroutine.create(function()end);u=io.stdout;arg={want,fn,co,u};check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==4 and v[1]==want and v[2]==fn and v[3]==co and v[4]==u);assert(type(v[1])=='table' and type(v[2])=='function' and type(v[3])=='thread' and type(v[4])=='userdata') end
cases.purpose: Preserve table/function/thread/userdata identity without string conversion.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-holes";len_calls=0;arg=setmetatable({[1]="left",[3]="right"},{__len=function(self) len_calls=len_calls+1;return 4 end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(len_calls==1 and v.n==4 and v[1]=='left' and v[2]==nil and v[3]=='right' and v[4]==nil) end
cases.purpose: Deterministic __len count preserves internal hole and trailing nil.

cases.setup: case_name="raw-indexing";index_calls=0;arg=setmetatable({[1]="first"},{__len=function()return 3 end,__index=function()index_calls=index_calls+1;error("ARG INDEX RAN",0)end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(index_calls==0 and v.n==3 and v[1]=='first' and v[2]==nil and v[3]==nil) end
cases.purpose: lua_rawgeti copies absent entries without table __index callback.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-number-string";len_calls=0;arg=setmetatable({7,8},{__len=function()len_calls=len_calls+1;return "2" end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(len_calls==1 and v.n==2 and v[1]==7 and v[2]==8) end
cases.purpose: luaL_len numeric-string conversion, distinct from host array size.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-float-integer";len_calls=0;arg=setmetatable({7,8},{__len=function()len_calls=len_calls+1;return 2.0 end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(len_calls==1 and v.n==2 and v[1]==7 and v[2]==8) end
cases.purpose: lua_tointegerx accepts integral real length.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-mutates-values";len_calls=0;arg=setmetatable({1,2},{__len=function(self)len_calls=len_calls+1;self[1]=17;self[2]=false;return 2 end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(len_calls==1 and v.n==2 and v[1]==17 and v[2]==false) end
cases.purpose: Slot reads happen after actual length callback.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-replaces-global-gc";len_calls=0;local t={};t[1]=t;weak=setmetatable({t},{__mode="v"});setmetatable(t,{__len=function(self)len_calls=len_calls+1;arg={99};collectgarbage();assert(weak[1]==self);self[2]=false;return 3 end});arg=t;t=nil;check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(len_calls==1 and v.n==3 and v[1]==weak[1] and type(v[1])=='table' and v[2]==false and v[3]==nil);assert(arg[1]==99);collectgarbage();assert(weak[1]==v[1]) end
cases.purpose: Captured original table remains rooted while __len replaces global arg and collects; raw reads keep that same table.

cases.setup: case_name="global-handler";arg=nil;arg_hits=0;setmetatable(_G,{__index=function(_,key)if key=="arg" then arg_hits=arg_hits+1;return {41,false}end end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(arg_hits==1 and v.n==2 and v[1]==41 and v[2]==false) end
cases.purpose: lua_getglobal(arg) uses actual environment lookup.

cases.setup: case_name="non-table-number";arg=1;check_dynamic_arg=function(v) error('SCRIPT INCORRECTLY ENTERED',0) end
cases.purpose: Original main277 non-table rejection.

cases.setup: case_name="non-table-nil";arg=nil;check_dynamic_arg=function(v) error('SCRIPT INCORRECTLY ENTERED',0) end
cases.purpose: Missing current global arg is a non-table failure.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-fraction";arg=setmetatable({},{__len=function()return 2.5 end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) error('SCRIPT INCORRECTLY ENTERED',0) end

expected.stderr_contains: object length is not an integer

cases.purpose: luaL_len rejects fractional length result.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-table-result";arg=setmetatable({},{__len=function()return {} end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) error('SCRIPT INCORRECTLY ENTERED',0) end

expected.stderr_contains: object length is not an integer

cases.purpose: luaL_len rejects nonnumeric length result.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-error";arg=setmetatable({},{__len=function()error("ARG LENGTH FAILURE",0)end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) error('SCRIPT INCORRECTLY ENTERED',0) end
cases.purpose: Length callback error aborts before selected script body.

cases.setup: case_name="metalen-yield";arg=setmetatable({},{__len=function()coroutine.yield("BAD")end});check_dynamic_arg=function(v) error('SCRIPT INCORRECTLY ENTERED',0) end

expected.stderr_contains: attempt to yield from outside a coroutine

cases.purpose: Native top-level CLI callback is not yieldable; observe actual native wording first.

cases.setup: case_name="arg-zero-does-not-retarget";arg[0]="wrong-script.lua";check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==3 and v[1]=='a' and arg[0]=='wrong-script.lua');assert(debug.getinfo(2,'S').source=='@selected script.lua') end
cases.purpose: Already selected script remains selected when arg[0] changes.

cases.setup: case_name="negative-index-does-not-retarget";arg[-1]="wrong-script.lua";check_dynamic_arg=function(v) assert(v.n==3 and v[1]=='a' and arg[-1]=='wrong-script.lua');assert(debug.getinfo(2,'S').source=='@selected script.lua') end
cases.purpose: Editing interpreter-side table entry does not replace selected script.
